sentences.text: Newcastle United Football Club is an English professional association football club based in Newcastle upon Tyne , that will play in the Premier League , the top tier of English football , after winning the Championship title in 2017 .	association football	association football	Newcastle upon Tyne	Newcastle upon Tyne	Premier League	Premier League	Championship	EFL Championship

Newcastle United was founded in 1892 by the merger of Newcastle East End and Newcastle West End , and has played at its current home ground , St James ' Park , ever since .	Newcastle East End	Newcastle East End F.C.	Newcastle West End	Newcastle West End F.C.
The ground was developed into an all-seater stadium in the mid-1990s and now has a capacity of 52,354 .	all-seater stadium	all-seater stadium

The club has been a member of the Premier League for all but three years of the competition 's history , spending 85 seasons in the top tier as of May 2016 , and has never dropped below English football 's second tier since joining the Football League in 1893 .	Premier League	Premier League	Football League	Football League

They have won four League Championship titles , six FA Cups and a Charity Shield , as well as the 1969 Inter-Cities Fairs Cup and the 2006 UEFA Intertoto Cup .	Championship	EFL Championship	League Championship	List of English football champions	Charity Shield	FA Community Shield	1969 Inter-Cities Fairs Cup	1969 Inter-Cities Fairs Cup Final	2006 UEFA Intertoto Cup	2006 UEFA Intertoto Cup
Newcastle United has the ninth highest total of trophies won by an English club .
The club 's most successful period was between 1904 and 1910 , when they won an FA Cup and three of their First Division titles .	FA Cup	FA Cup

The club were highly successful in the Premier League in the 1990s and early 2000s without winning any trophies , but have been mostly struggling since the 2006 -- 07 season , and were relegated in 2009 and 2016 .	Premier League	Premier League
Newcastle has a fierce local rivalry with Sunderland , and the two clubs have engaged in the Tyne -- Wear derby since 1898 .	Sunderland	Sunderland A.F.C.
The club 's traditional kit colours are black and white striped shirts , black shorts and black socks .
Their traditional crest takes elements of the city coat of arms , which features two grey seahorses .	coat of arms	coat of arms
The club has been owned by Mike Ashley since 2007 , succeeding long term chairman and owner Sir John Hall .	Mike Ashley	Mike Ashley (businessman)	Sir John Hall	John Hall (businessman)
The club is the seventeenth highest revenue producing club in the world in terms of annual revenue , generating $ 169.3 m in 2015 .	seventeenth	Deloitte Football Money League

Historically , Newcastle 's highest placing was in 1999 when they were the fifth highest revenue producing football club in the world , and second in England only behind Manchester United .	Manchester United	Manchester United F.C.
